en-US.name: pixelfx
en-US.summary: Optional local MIT package of the pixelfx skill for making pixel-art effects. The effect library and Node tools stay in the same MIT repo and must be checked out separately. gallery/fonts is not covered by the repo MIT license and is not in this package. Optional pch CLI install uses a remote script and needs operator review.
en-US.description: Market-local packaging of patch-gg/pixelfx@5294518ce7c72e48b6100a744596e0acf57f2826 path skills/pixelfx, with the upstream MIT LICENSE and NOTICE.md placed in the installed tree (the installer copies only this content directory). The effect library is not vendored here. Package version 2026.11.24.

zh-CN.name: pixelfx
zh-CN.summary: 用 pixelfx 制作像素特效的可选 MIT 本地技能包。特效库和 Node 工具在同一 MIT 仓库中，需另行检出。gallery/fonts 不受仓库 MIT 许可覆盖，也不在本包内。可选 pch CLI 通过远程脚本安装，需操作者自行审核。
zh-CN.description: 基于 patch-gg/pixelfx@5294518ce7c72e48b6100a744596e0acf57f2826 路径 skills/pixelfx 的市场本地包装，把上游 MIT LICENSE 与 NOTICE.md 放进安装产物（安装器只复制本内容目录）。特效库不在本包中。包版本 2026.11.24。

requirements.value: A DesireCore-compatible client that can install this optional local skill.
The pixelfx effect library and Node tools are not in this package; check out pin 5294518ce7c72e48b6100a744596e0acf57f2826 separately when you need to build effects.

Optional pch CLI installation uses a remote script and must be reviewed by the operator before execution. This package does not run remote scripts. gallery/fonts is not licensed as MIT and is not shipped.
